content.value_statement: Complex web research can become fragmented across searches, notes, and sources. This skill plans the work, delegates focused searches, and synthesizes cited findings.
actual_capabilities: Creates a dedicated research folder and research_plan.md file for each topic.
Breaks broad questions into 2 to 5 non-overlapping subtopics.
Uses task subagents for separate web research streams.
Limits subagents to 3 to 5 searches and collects source URLs.
Reads saved findings and synthesizes a cited final answer.
Uses fetch_url for web pages instead of read_file.
limitations: Requires task, web_search, write_file, read_file, list_files, and fetch_url tools.
Quality depends on the search provider and available web pages.
It writes research artifacts to the local workspace.
It does not verify claims beyond the sources it collects.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Research Brief
use_cases.description: Gather current information from multiple sources and synthesize a cited brief for decision support.

use_cases.title: Compare Products or Markets
use_cases.description: Split a comparison into focused subtopics, collect evidence, and summarize tradeoffs with source URLs.

use_cases.title: Support Technical Content
use_cases.description: Collect recent references, examples, and source links before writing documentation or educational material.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to research [topic]. Create a plan, search key sources, and summarize the findings with source URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to compare [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Separate subtopics by option and synthesize tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Market Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to create a market brief on [market]. Include recent trends, major organizations, risks, and cited sources.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multi-Part Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the web-research skill to investigate [complex question]. Split the work into 3 to 5 subtopics, delegate focused searches, then produce a final report with gaps and source links.

output_examples.input: Research current pricing and core features for three customer support platforms.
output_examples.output: A concise comparison covering each platform, major feature differences, pricing notes, source URLs, and gaps that need follow-up.

output_examples.input: Find recent information about new regulations affecting a software category.
output_examples.output: A dated research brief with key regulatory changes, source links, affected stakeholders, and uncertainties that require expert review.

best_practices: Start with a narrow research question and clear decision criteria.
Review the saved research plan before launching subagents.
Check cited URLs and note gaps when sources disagree.
anti_patterns: Launching many subagents for a simple fact question.
Using read_file for URLs instead of fetch_url.
Treating collected sources as verified truth without cross-checking.

faq.question: Does this skill browse the web directly?
faq.answer: It coordinates web research through tools such as web_search and fetch_url when those tools are available.

faq.question: Can it create files?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks the agent and subagents to save plans, findings, and optional reports in the workspace.

faq.question: Does it work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the required tools are present.

faq.question: How many searches does it run?
faq.answer: It recommends 3 to 5 web searches per subtopic and up to 3 subagents in parallel.

faq.question: Can it produce citations?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs subagents to include source URLs and asks the final synthesis to cite specific sources.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive data?
faq.answer: Do not include secrets or private data in research prompts because the workflow may use web tools and local files.
